cohort_grammar.idea: Subsidized-Time documents: every opener is a dated bureaucratic artifact (admissions file, waiting-room memo, clinical transcript, incident log, memo mailer, field recording, dorm-room cassette, scouting report, tunnel map, rap sheet, sick-slip, institutional prospectus, game-day program). Shared grammar = a date-stamp band + a document-form opener + one authored motif; the artifact TYPE changes per chapter so neighbors rhyme without cloning.
cohort_grammar.date_band: Each opener carries its Subsidized Year / calendar date as a stamped band; p1c1's Year of Glad sets the far-future anchor, the rest settle into Y.D.A.U./adjacent years.
cohort_grammar.palette_role: Cohort A owns the cold institutional register of the book: enamel greens, fluorescent whites, bruise violets, warning reds — bureaucratic dread before the warmer Ennet/ETA interiors arrive later in the book.
cohort_grammar.reading_treatments: Dialogue-heavy chapters (c1,c3,c7) get speaker-breathing rhythm + turn rules; monolith chapters (c2,c5,c10,c12) get drop-cap anchors + section air; short chapters (c4,c11) get single-gesture treatments; p1c13's two-halve split gets a visible intermission seam.
